title: I-008 leftover handles, boundary continuity, and atomic undo
clauseOfficialized: Missing dissolve handles are TRANSITION_HANDLE_MISSING and missing luma handles are HANDLE_UNAVAILABLE, with no freeze fallback and no document change, including when a transform2d curve is already present. Existing codes are not retargeted. Registered transform2d@1.0.0 linear keys are continuous at knots; a split matches both remnants at the cut; a trim interpolates the new boundary. TransformKeyframeProposal coalesces 30 drag samples of one key into a single commit; InversePatch kind is restoreSnapshot; one undo restores the start content hash as a new revision of that snapshot; cancel writes nothing; a later refusal does not half-write.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increments 2.05 and 2.12 admitted transform2d keyframes and officialized overwrite-crop / luma refusal coverage, but explicitly left 缺handles拒, 关键帧边界连续, and 一次提案原子undo恢复hash listed and not re-qualified. There was no coalescing restoreSnapshot proposal for a transform2d key drag, and no official I-008 leftover suite binding those three items.
